objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the redirect result evaluate an OGNL expression, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The form action redirects with your name in the URL. Read the S2-012 advisory on how a redirect result builds its location.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework handles the form? (name only)

steps.title: Name the advisory
steps.prompt: Which Struts security bulletin covers this bug?

steps.title: Find the parameter
steps.prompt: Which form field reaches the redirect location? (field name)
